title.narrative: Expanding the Kaizen initiative by enhancing sustainable agribusiness

description.narrative: Introduction and mainstreaming of Smart and Sustainable Agri-Business (SSAB) approach through Ghana's national initiatives. SSAB is an approach that enhances the enterprise performance of agri-businesses by collecting key performance indicators in the areas of productivity, quality and energy and resource efficiency, and analyzing them for enterprise performance improvement. The government of Ghana puts high priority in agro and food industry promotion and has requested UNIDO to support further the sector in line with its national initiatives.
